BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to contracts with chiropractors; adding a newsection to chapter 48.43 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Health carriers may not directly or indirectly, throughcontract or otherwise, refuse to reimburse for the health care serviceslegally provided by employees of a contracted chiropractor working atthe same location as the contracted chiropractor if the service wouldbe a reimbursable benefit but for the contractor's refusal to recognizeor reimburse the services performed by employees of the contractedchiropractor. (2) Health carriers may not require directly or indirectly, bycontract or otherwise, that a chiropractor comply with health carereimbursement or delivery standards that conflict with those standardsand practices authorized or adopted by the Washington statechiropractic quality assurance commission. A contract may not prohibita chiropractor from delegating duties in accordance with rulesgoverning the chiropractic profession, nor may a contractor refuse to p. 1 SSB 5597reimburse the contracted chiropractor for such delegated services ifthose services would be reimbursed if not delegated. A carrier mayrequire all contracted health care providers to participate in aquality assurance program that relies upon evidencebased health caredelivery standards. (3) Any term or condition of any contract between a chiropractorand a carrier that violates a provision of this section and any attemptto waive, modify, or shift responsibility for compliance with thissection is invalid.
This act does not affect any existing rightacquired or liability or obligation incurred prior to the effectivedate of this act.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
Every provider contract executed or renewedon or after January 1, 2008, shall conform to the provisions of thisact.
